error_troubleshooting_modal.title: Troubleshooting Help

passkey_overview.title: About Passkeys
passkey_overview.description: Passkeys are a more secure and convenient way to sign in. They use your device's biometric authentication (fingerprint, face recognition) or PIN.
passkey_overview.benefit2: No passwords to remember or lose
passkey_overview.benefit3: Encrypted and stored only on your device

passkey_faq.question1: What if I accidentally cancelled the request?
passkey_faq.answer1: Simply click the 'Retry' button to restart the authentication process.
passkey_faq.question2: Why is my device not showing the biometric prompt?
passkey_faq.answer2: Ensure your device screen is unlocked and you haven't disabled biometric authentication in your system settings.
passkey_faq.question3: What if I haven't set up biometrics yet?
passkey_faq.answer3: You can usually use your device's screen lock PIN or pattern as a fallback, or set up a fingerprint/face recognition in your device settings.
passkey_faq.question4: Are there specific browser permissions needed?
passkey_faq.answer4: Some browsers may require permission to access security keys. Check your browser settings if you're experiencing issues.
passkey_faq.answer5: Most modern devices and browsers support passkeys. If you're on an older system, you may need to update your software.
passkey_faq.question6: The request timed out. What should I do?
passkey_faq.answer6: Authentication requests have a time limit. If it expires, please try again.

error_troubleshooting_modal.biometric_help_description: If you're having trouble with fingerprint or face recognition:
error_troubleshooting_modal.biometric_help_point1: Ensure your sensor is clean and dry.
error_troubleshooting_modal.biometric_help_point2: Try using your device PIN if biometrics fail multiple times.
error_troubleshooting_modal.biometric_help_point3: Restart your device if the biometric system seems unresponsive.
error_troubleshooting_modal.still_need_help_description: If none of the above solutions work, please contact our support team for further assistance.
